_why_built: Built from source with our patches rather than downloaded. The gyan.dev build this used to pin has the WHIP muxer upstream ships, which refuses every NACK LiveKit sends (they arrive inside compound RTCP; see ffmpeg/patches/0001), so on the ffmpeg route no lost packet was ever retransmitted. The version here is what the release workflow checks the built binary against, as '<version>-zoia'; the Dockerfile's FFMPEG_VERSION must match it.
_why_gnutls: Must be a GnuTLS build. An ffmpeg built against Windows SChannel completes the DTLS handshake and then fails with 'no SRTP Protection Profile was chosen', because SChannel has no use_srtp extension, so WHIP cannot work with it at all. See desktop/src/main/encoder.ts.
